relations: Ophelia 建造了 penitentiary；Dante 是她的吸血鬼 mate，结 bond 不到二十四小时。
Callum Frost 掌管 Cabinet，与她是友好敌人；mate Kat 是热情的金发 werewolf。
Rae 与 Darius 是 Callum 家访客，一对发光 soulmate。
Grayson 富有且知道她住址；两人只见过一面。

facts.fact: 出狱当晚吃掉最后一杯杯面，次日查账户只剩 $0.94。
facts.anchor: I ate my last cup of noodles the evening of the same day I got out of prison.

facts.fact: 身无分文的她收拾整齐开车去 Callum 家。
facts.anchor: washed my bangs in the sink, and even put on a little mascara before I drove to Callum Frost's house.

facts.fact: 她告诉 Callum 还有 a hundred 名无辜者要救。
facts.anchor: There are a hundred more people I need to break out.

facts.fact: 监狱被当武器用了 Thirty years。
facts.anchor: Probably? How long has it been used as a weapon?

facts.fact: Callum 免提拨通 Dante，她抢挂失败。
facts.anchor: I tried to reach over and end the call, but Callum slid the phone away right as Dante picked up.

facts.fact: Dante 电话里说「我们是 mate，我永远喂饱你」，她挂断。
facts.anchor: I'm trying to process the fact that you couldn't afford food and went to Callum, Ophelia.

facts.fact: Callum 开条件：详细 write-up+计划+时长才给 Cabinet 钱。
facts.anchor: The Cabinet will provide money for food and your time as soon as we've seen a detailed write-up

facts.fact: Dante 威胁闯脑、宣布带食物上门（车程约一小时），她答应回家等。
facts.anchor: I got your address from Grayson, and I'm heading to your house right now. With food.
